# It charges and bites him (316) while he whips it three times. Each swing's oWhip lasts 7 steps (306-312,
# 318-324, 330-336), and oEnemy's collision with it takes the whip's damage (1) on every step they overlap,
# with no pause between hits: the first swing catches it on its last step (40 to 39, 312), the second on all
# seven (38 on 318 to 32 on 324), the third on three (31 to 29, 330-332).
